meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord, Mr Alvarez, about the broken heating in apartment 4B and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes. To: landlord@example.com; Subject: Heating not working in apartment 4B; the body starts "Dear Mr. Alvarez," and is signed Alex. A tone switch between Polite and Firm rewrites the body: the Polite one asks "Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?", the Firm one says "Please confirm by Thursday when a repair will be carried out." Send and Discard buttons; Send needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows "Sent to" the address with the subject and the body as it was sent.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Email to landlord" "Draft for apartment 4B" icon:"mail" status:"Draft" tone:accent w:390
  state tone="Polite"
  state to="landlord@example.com"
  state subject="Heating not working in apartment 4B"
  state body="Dear Mr. Alvarez,\n\nThe heating in apartment 4B has stopped working. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?\n\nThank you,\nAlex"
  state sent=false
  state sentTo=""
  state sentSubject=""
  state sentBody=""
  if !sent
    SectionLabel "Tone"
    Segments =tone options:["Polite","Firm"] -> body=result=="Polite"?"Dear Mr. Alvarez,\n\nThe heating in apartment 4B has stopped working. Could you please arrange for someone to take a look this week?\n\nThank you,\nAlex":"Dear Mr. Alvarez,\n\nThe heating in apartment 4B has stopped working. Please confirm by Thursday when a repair will be carried out.\n\nRegards,\nAlex"
    InputField "To" "name@example.com" =to icon:"person" keyboard:"emailAddress" error:=trim(to)==""?"A recipient is required":""
    InputField "Subject" "Subject" =subject error:=trim(subject)==""?"A subject is required":""
    InputField "Message" "Write your message" =body lines:9
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Discard" tone:quiet -> to=""; subject=""; body=""
      ActionButton "Send" tone:primary icon:"send" enabled:=trim(to)!=""&&trim(subject)!="" -> sentTo=to; sentSubject=subject; sentBody=body; sent=true
  if sent
    Receipt "Sent" "Sent to {sentTo}" tone:good
    Details rows:=[["To",sentTo],["Subject",sentSubject]]
    SectionLabel "Message"
    Paragraph "{sentBody}"

delta: someone to take a look this week
someone to take a look this week
